principles: Fix annotation compliance without changing executable behavior.
Prefer preserving useful developer context over deleting comments wholesale.
Make convergence_check and lint:tasks agree on a clean annotation state.
drivers: 64 validator errors currently block project convergence.
The affected comments are localized to 11 locations.
The compliance risk signal is a process false positive, so the implementation must stay low-risk and mechanical.

options.name: A: Normalize malformed comments at the affected locations
cons: Requires choosing per location whether to keep structured annotation or convert to prose

options.name: B: Relax the annotation validator to ignore inline explanatory @task text
cons: Changes checker semantics and may hide real malformed annotations
Higher risk because convergence relies on this validator

options.name: C: Remove all affected comments
pros: Fastest way to silence parser errors
cons: Loses useful context and preMortem anchors
Could make future reviewers miss why gate behavior exists

chosen: A: Normalize malformed comments at the affected locations
rationale: Choose the smallest behavior-preserving cleanup: repair only the comments that lint:tasks reports, preserving intent while keeping validator semantics strict.

preMortem.scenario: A comment edit accidentally changes executable code nearby.
preMortem.trigger: Patch includes non-comment lines or formatting tools rewrite code blocks.
preMortem.consequence: Runtime behavior changes under a cleanup story.
preMortem.mitigation: Diff review must confirm only comment/annotation text changed, then run build.

preMortem.scenario: Validator passes but convergence_check still fails.
preMortem.trigger: lint:tasks is fixed but convergence_check has another annotation path or stale build output.
preMortem.consequence: User still sees converged=false after cleanup.
preMortem.mitigation: Run npm run lint:tasks and koala convergence_check after build; inspect remaining failed row if any.

preMortem.scenario: Converting @task tags to prose removes metadata needed by task_coverage.
preMortem.trigger: A genuinely structured file-level annotation is converted instead of completed.
preMortem.consequence: Annotation coverage loses a useful trace link.
preMortem.mitigation: For file-level story annotations, prefer completing required fields; convert only inline explanatory comments that are not intended as metadata.
